interpretation: Successful TokaMark MAST intake after runtime-path repair. Public CC BY 4.0 task-ready repackaging of FAIR-MAST confirmed with 11,573 shots, 39 signals, and 14 tasks. This is dataset/provenance intake only and does not constitute independent cross-machine evidence or causal TCT actuator validation.
shot_ids: Corpus-level intake; no individual shot IDs evaluated.
claim_boundary: TokaMark is a task-ready repackaging of FAIR-MAST MAST shots, not an independent machine. No causal TCT suppression, segmented-electrode efficacy, native M3D-C1 validation, p-B11 physics, or reactor-scale claim.
pb11_fidelity_limits: Not a p-B11 job; no p-B11 inference.
